categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies wallet unit test suites in src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp and src/wallet/test/coinselector_tests.cpp to test CoinGrinder coin selection.
categories.rationale: Migrates CoinGrinder tests from the legacy coin selector test suite to use realistic feerates and effective values. This improves test fidelity and helps consolidate coin selection testing towards eventual deprecation of the legacy test file, but does not alter production wallet behavior.
